problem.noHold.message: Nothing is held at {provider}'s warm-up cap for this campaign.

problem.pickTarget: Pick another connected provider to move the held share to.

notify.capHoldTitle.note: PR-8: a notification to the members who can send; campaign: its name, never translated

notify.capHoldBody.message: {count, plural, one {# recipient waits} other {# recipients wait}} on {provider}: {reason, select, paused {its warm-up is paused. They go out when it resumes} other {today's warm-up cap is used up. They go out with tomorrow's cap from {resume, time}}}, unless you move them to a warm provider or cancel the rest.
notify.capHoldBody.note: PR-8: reason is paused or cap; resume is when the next day's cap starts

problem.complete: This warm-up is complete. Start a new plan to warm up again.
problem.providerNotConnected: That provider is not connected to this workspace.

problem.planExists.message: {provider} already has a warm-up plan. Change its settings instead.
problem.planExists.note: provider: a sending provider's name, never translated

problem.tooShort.message: This plan already counted {counted, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} and is on day {day}, so it can't be shorter than {day, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
problem.tooShort.note: a warm-up plan's length is in counted days

log.started.message: Plan started by {named, select, no {someone} other {{name}}}: {days, plural, one {# counted day} other {# counted days}}, {order, select, random {random sample} other {engaged-first}}.
log.started.note: the warm-up log; name: a member's name; counted days: a day counts once most of its cap went out with healthy rates; engaged-first: the most engaged contacts get the first days' mail

log.settings: Plan settings changed by {named, select, no {someone} other {{name}}}.

log.paused.message: Warm-up paused by {named, select, no {someone} other {{name}}}. No mail goes to {provider} until it resumes.

log.resumed: Warm-up resumed by {named, select, no {someone} other {{name}}}.

log.slowdownTitle.note: the bold lead of a log entry when the warm-up guard tripped

log.slowdown.message: {metric, select, complaint {Complaints hit {rate, number, ::percent .00} (guard {guardDigits, select, 0 {{guard, number, percent}} 1 {{guard, number, ::percent .0}} other {{guard, number, ::percent .00}}})} other {Bounces hit {rate, number, ::percent .0} (guard {guardDigits, select, 0 {{guard, number, percent}} 1 {{guard, number, ::percent .0}} other {{guard, number, ::percent .00}}})}}{mailbox, select, none {} rest {, mostly Other} other {, mostly {mailbox}}}. {action, select, pause {The plan is paused until someone resumes it.} step_back {Day {day} steps back to {cap, number}.} other {Day {day} cap held at {cap, number}.}}
log.slowdown.note: the guard tripped on a day of the warm-up. rate and guard: percentages; mailbox: the mailbox provider most bounces came from (Gmail, Outlook…), rest the other mailbox providers; cap: emails a day

log.rampResumed: Ramp resumed: bounces back to {bounce, number, ::percent .0}.

log.dayComplete.message: Day {day} complete: {sent, number} sent{inside, select, yes { inside "{campaign}"} other {}}, bounce {bounce, number, ::percent .0}.
log.dayComplete.note: campaign: the campaign that used the provider that day, never translated

log.shareRaised.message: Broadcast share raised to {share, number, percent} on day {day}.
log.shareRaised.note: share: the provider's share of the Broadcasts stream

log.done.message: {provider} is eligible as a Broadcast failover target.

log.shifted.message: {provider} was down during a send and its share moved to another provider. Today still counts if at least 80% of its cap goes out; otherwise today's step repeats tomorrow.
log.shifted.note: provider: a sending provider's name; PR-8: a day counts once 80% of its cap went out

log.dayCounted.message: Day {day} counted: {sent, number} sent{inside, select, yes { inside "{campaign}"} other {}}, bounce {bounce, number, ::percent .0}.
log.dayCounted.note: PR-8: the day moved the plan on; campaign: the campaign that used the provider that day, never translated

log.dayShort.message: {sent, plural, =0 {Nothing sent} other {{sent, number} of {cap, number} sent}}, so day {day} repeated on {weekday, select, monday {Monday} tuesday {Tuesday} wednesday {Wednesday} thursday {Thursday} friday {Friday} saturday {Saturday} sunday {Sunday} other {the next day}}.
log.dayShort.note: PR-8: under 80% of the day's cap went out; weekday: the day the plan day repeated

log.todayRepeats.message: {sent, plural, =0 {Nothing is scheduled today} other {Nothing more is scheduled today ({sent, number} of {need, number} sent)}}, so day {day} doesn't count and repeats tomorrow.
log.todayRepeats.note: PR-8: today's line of the warm-up log while nothing more is scheduled for the warming provider today; need: 80% of today's cap

log.slowdownCounted.message: {metric, select, complaint {Complaints hit {rate, number, ::percent .00} (guard {guardDigits, select, 0 {{guard, number, percent}} 1 {{guard, number, ::percent .0}} other {{guard, number, ::percent .00}}})} other {Bounces hit {rate, number, ::percent .0} (guard {guardDigits, select, 0 {{guard, number, percent}} 1 {{guard, number, ::percent .0}} other {{guard, number, ::percent .00}}})}}{mailbox, select, none {} rest {, mostly Other} other {, mostly {mailbox}}}. Day {day} didn't count; {action, select, pause {the plan is paused until someone resumes it.} step_back {the cap steps back to {cap, number} until {healthy} healthy days in a row.} other {the cap holds at {cap, number} until {healthy} healthy days in a row.}}
log.slowdownCounted.note: PR-8: a guard tripped; rate and guard: percentages; mailbox: the mailbox provider most bounces came from

log.healthy.message: Healthy day {streak} of {healthy} at the held cap (bounces {bounce, number, ::percent .0}).
log.healthy.note: PR-8: a counted day while a slowdown holds the cap

log.holdEnded.message: Second healthy day at the held cap (bounces {bounce, number, ::percent .0}), so the ramp resumes with day {day} at {cap, number}.
log.holdEnded.note: PR-8: two counted days in a row end a slowdown's hold

log.resumedOn.message: Warm-up resumed by {named, select, no {someone} other {{name}}} on day {day}{skipped, plural, =0 {} one {; the paused day didn't count} other {; the # paused days didn't count}}.
log.resumedOn.note: PR-8: a pause freezes the plan

status.pausedByGuard.message: Paused by the guard on day {day}
status.pausedByGuard.note: a warm-up plan's status line under its title

status.held.message: Cap held at {cap, number} until {healthy} healthy days in a row
status.held.note: PR-8: a warm-up plan's status line while a slowdown holds the cap
